scope: Settlement-date eligibility for the requested EOW PM / standard monthly AM forecast targets. Not a strike-level chain, liquidity or historical listing-time archive.
third_friday_pm_distinction: The May 2017 symbol conversion added existing third-Friday PM series to SPXW. These are not the EOW target even though their symbol is SPXW.

reviewed_local_documents.use: Retrospective EOW/monthly AM symbol definitions; not sole proof of eligibility. Contains stale pilot-expiry boilerplate referring to 2019.
Wednesday SPXW is a separate expiry family and does not substitute for EOW.
Independent explicit Friday EOW examples; this notice changes listing lead times, not settlement dates.

rules: Actual standard monthly dates come from the hash-pinned visual calendar transcription, never an unadjusted third-Friday fallback.
EOW nominal weeks are Friday-identified, with settlement on the preceding verified session when Friday is closed.
Standard-monthly and last-regular-session-of-month collisions are excluded from the EOW target. Quarter-end is a month-end subset.
Each included historical EOW date must also have an explicit SPXW PM record in the supplied source archive. Absence of a record never proves ineligibility.
Excluded rows mean ineligible for this model's EOW target; they do not assert that no other PM contract existed.
No future expirations are asserted from calendar rules alone. The build stops at the requested as-of date.
Weeks whose prior-week reference needs dates outside the verified calendar are reported separately, not marked ineligible.
